Scene 02

[ screaming ]

Nurse Charters

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

Dana Scully

The victim has filed a lawsuit against the federal government. She seems to be certain who the spirit being is.

Scene 05
